adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` the new fallback for `updateEvent` (and similarly for `deleteEvent`) is:

```ts
const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId
  ? externalCalendarId
  : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;
```

When `externalCalendarId` is falsy/empty (the exact case the fallback is meant to handle), the `.find(... cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)` compares against that same falsy value, so it will almost always return `undefined` rather than selecting a destination calendar. Previously the fallback was `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` (i.e., it would use the destination calendar when no external id was stored). This is a concrete behavior regression introduced by the diff and can cause updates/deletes to target the wrong calendar (e.g., default/primary) or pass an undefined calendar id depending on how the subsequent call uses `selectedCalendar`/`calendarId`.
